title: Landscape of Cell States and Multicellular Ecotypes in Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer.
snippet: Non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC) is the most prevalent type of lung cancer and remains a major global health burden. Comprehensive characterization of tumor microenvironment (TME) heterogeneity is critical for understanding tumor progression and clinical outcomes in NSCLC.
